features.name: Search generative AI control
limitations: Property setting in Search Console Settings > Search generative AI; supports include, exclude, and inheritance from a parent property. Child owners can override inheritance; verify the actual property state before implementation.

Exclusion covers links, visible content, and response grounding in the listed generative AI surfaces. It is not a ranking or inclusion signal for other Search areas and does not override Merchant Center or Google Ads participation.

This visibility control does not affect AI training. Google-Extended is a separate product token; it has no separate HTTP user agent and is not the Search visibility control. Googlebot crawl rules, snippet controls, and noindex remain distinct.

effective_at is the documented worldwide rollout date (day precision), not the initial launch or an exact activation time. The control-what-you-share documentation update on 2026-10-21 is a separate source update, not the rollout date.

Exclusion generally takes a few days; the help page describes 1-2 days after the control goes live with possible caching and propagation delays. Verify the eventual property outcome rather than guaranteeing a deadline.
